formulas.name: Promise or Curiosity Hook
formulas.template: [3-8 word title] (makes a promise or teases curiosity)
examples: Whole Foods has gotten SHADIER than ever 😳
PSYCHOLOGIST EXPLAINS HOW TO STOP FEELING EXHAUSTED 😩
How To Fix Shoulder Blade Pain

formulas.name: Promise or Curiosity Teaser
formulas.template: [3-8 words] that makes a promise or teases curiosity.
examples: Whole Foods has gotten SHADIER than ever
PSYCHOLOGIST EXPLAINS HOW TO STOP FEELING EXHAUSTED

formulas.name: Contrarian (Counterintuitive Truth)
formulas.template: Why [Common Belief] is actually hurting your [Desired Outcome]
examples: Posting daily kills engagement

formulas.name: Fortune Teller (Secret Reveal)
formulas.template: [Number] secrets [Authority Figure] doesn't want you to know
examples: 3 YouTube secrets Mr. Beast hides
5 contractor secrets stores hide

formulas.name: Result Preview (Transformation Tease)
formulas.template: How I went from [Bad Situation] to [Good Situation] in [Timeframe]
examples: 10 leads to 1000 in 90 days
2 home sales to 50 yearly

I'm flopping

formulas.name: Call to Attention Hook

formulas.name: Fortuneteller
formulas.template: Present vs. Future: Establish current reality, hint at future change, tease new future as possibility.
examples: New microwave changes cooking forever.
Blue light will impact traffic.
Largest breakthroughs in marketing.
Animation just changed forever.

formulas.name: Experimenter
formulas.template: Peer-to-Peer Demo: Establish pain point, show how a new method/tool solved it via experiment, explain why it works.
examples: Does anything look weird about this shot?
I'm recording with these glasses.
ChatGPT's new AI agent controls my computer!

formulas.name: Teacher
formulas.template: Teacher-to-Student Lesson: Establish pain point, present a solution/learning, explain how it works to help them win.
examples: 3 things you can learn from Aritzia.
Here's how I got this shot.
Ecom brand made $1M in 12 hours.

formulas.name: Magician
formulas.template: Stun Gun: Use a quick, atypical, visually/audibly stunning element to grab attention, then transition to another hook format.
examples: China China China
What's up MTV Cribs!
Yo, check this out.
Check this out...

formulas.name: Investigator
formulas.template: Secret/Unknown: Tee up a secret or unknown finding, then reveal it, creating contrast between not knowing and knowing.
examples: Sneakier marketing campaigns I've seen.
Secret Japanese city at Mount Fuji.

formulas.name: Have You Heard About
